name: clean-shared-money-format
title: Clean — two drifted money formatters become one shared helper

pullRequest.title: Share one money formatter across the invoice routes
pullRequest.body: The invoice routes each had their own money formatter and they had drifted: the single-invoice route divided every amount by 100, so a JPY invoice for 1299 showed as 12.99. This moves the correct one, which asks `src/lib/currency.ts` for the exponent, to `src/lib/money.ts` with tests, and points both routes at it.
pullRequest.author: lena-fischer
